content: Ethylparaben, also known as ethyl para-hydroxybenzoate, is the ethyl ester derivative of p-hydroxybenzoic acid. Its chemical structure is represented by the formula HO-C6H4-CO-O-CH2CH3. This compound belongs to the chemical class known as parabens. It is primarily utilized as an antifungal preservative in various applications. When used as a food additive, it is assigned the E number E214. Additionally, the sodium salt form of ethylparaben, known as sodium ethyl para-hydroxybenzoate, serves similar purposes and is designated with the E number E215.
